patterns.name: crypto.des_feistel_round
patterns.source: FIPS-46-3 (Data Encryption Standard, withdrawn 2005 but spec preserved); Wikipedia DES
patterns.description: DES Feistel F-function suspect: 32->48 bit expansion (no rotation in F-function — rotations exist only in DES key schedule), 8 S-box LUT substitutions (8x movzx), P-permutation. xor_min raised to 8 to enforce per-round XOR density.
patterns.spec_citation: NIST FIPS 46-3 §3 (DES algorithm) -- F-function has no rotation
patterns._note: shr/shl/and required works for inlined bit-shifted F; table-driven DES (table lookups) will not match — see future crypto.des_table_lookup

patterns.name: crypto.salsa20_quarter
patterns.source: Bernstein Salsa20 design + eSTREAM portfolio submission
patterns.description: Salsa20 quarter-round (Bernstein spec): b ^= (a+d) <<< 7; c ^= (b+a) <<< 9; d ^= (c+b) <<< 13; a ^= (d+c) <<< 18.
patterns._note: Combined sigma constants + rotation immediates is acceptable; consider future split into init/quarter detectors for cleaner separation

patterns.name: crypto.hmac_ipad_opad
patterns.source: RFC 2104 (HMAC: Keyed-Hashing for Message Authentication) + FIPS-198-1
patterns.description: HMAC inner/outer hash construction: K XOR ipad (0x36) || msg, then K XOR opad (0x5C) || H(...). Two hash invocations with byte-XOR pad blocks.

patterns.name: crypto.tea_round
patterns.source: Wheeler & Needham 1994 'TEA, a Tiny Encryption Algorithm' (Fast Software Encryption 1994 proceedings)
patterns.description: TEA round per Wheeler-Needham FSE 1994 §3: F(v) = ((v<<4)+k_a) XOR (v+sum) XOR ((v>>5)+k_b). Spec-derived gates: requires TEA delta 0x9E3779B9 (also matches 2's-complement 0x61C88647 emitted by sub/lea forms), and forbids ChaCha20 sigma constants to avoid mnemonic-level false matches when junk rotations are present.  Per-round counts: xor>=4, add>=6, shl>=1, shr>=1.
patterns.spec_citation: Wheeler & Needham, TEA: Tiny Encryption Algorithm (FSE 1994, Springer LNCS 1008, §3 equation + delta value)
